kill_fact: The catalyst is real and unfired - I confirm that independently - but the asymmetry is gone on the other two legs, and the floor is worse than the board's own corrected number. On 7 March 2024, the session before its last Phase 3 readout, AMLX closed at $18.97. Today it closes at $19.49. The same company, at the same price, on the same kind of binary, closed at $3.36 the next morning - an 82.3% single-session loss - and then kept going, closing at $1.62 on 18 June 2024, fourteen weeks later, while holding about $5.38 per share of cash. Cash at the LUCIDITY readout will be roughly $1.85 per share, LESS than that 2024 shell had, so the $3.00 'verified floor' is not a floor: it is approximately the day-one clearing price of the precedent, and the precedent then fell a further 52% below it over the following quarter. The honest 90-day failure mark is $2.00 to $2.50, i.e. -87% to -90%, against +54% to a $30 win the market has already paid for. At $19.49 the implied success probability is about 61% against a fair 55-65% read, with the stock 0.6% off its 52-week high after a 5.9% session. Note also that this shard's own prior pass confirmed the name on 2026-06-29 at $15.67; the stock has since risen 24% on no new company information (the only release since is unrelated Phase 1 ALS biomarker data on 23 June 2026). That drift is precisely what closed the spread. There is nothing left to capture and no floor to bound the loss - a fairly-priced coin flip with a fat left tail, not an event mispricing.
corrections: 1) MATERIAL - the downside floor. $3.00 is too generous on any horizon longer than one session. Verified closing prices: 7 Mar 2024 $18.97 -> 8 Mar 2024 $3.36 (-82.3%), then $1.65 on 17 Jun 2024 and $1.62 on 18 Jun 2024. The $3.36 day-one print is the analogue of the board's $3.00; the $1.62 close is where the same shareholder base actually left the stock, holding MORE cash per share than AMLX will hold at the LUCIDITY readout. Mark the failure case at $2.00-$2.50 and the loss at -87% to -90%. Footnote: the dossier's '$1.58 all-time low on 17 June 2024' is an intraday tick - closing basis was $1.65 on 17 Jun and $1.62 on 18 Jun. 2) MATERIAL - the success-case TAM is over-anchored. The ~160,000 US prevalent-patient figure the $30 target rests on is Amylyx's own estimate for PBH across BOTH sleeve gastrectomy and Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (Q1-2026 release, 'About PBH'). LUCIDITY (NCT06747468) enrolls ONLY adults with PBH following RYGB, so an initial label would cover a subset of that 160,000, not all of it. The path to ~$1bn peak sales therefore requires a post-approval expansion into sleeve-gastrectomy PBH with no pivotal trial behind it today. $30 is the ceiling of the win case, not its midpoint. 3) MATERIAL, and this one cuts FOR the bull on odds - the bear thesis's claim that a 78-patient trial 'has very little cushion' is contradicted by the company's own primary disclosure. The 24 Mar 2026 8-K exhibit states LUCIDITY 'is estimated to be >=90% powered to detect a 35% relative improvement over placebo even with up to a 50% placebo effect,' against a 64% Phase 2b composite reduction (p=0.0031). The trial needs roughly half the observed effect and already assumes a heavy placebo response. Caveat: company-stated power, and Phase 2b was N=16 per arm, so it is not independent - but the specific 'no cushion' framing must be dropped. Correcting it raises P(success) toward the top of 55-65%, which still does not rescue the setup: at 65% odds and a $2.25 failure mark, probability-weighted value is $30.00x0.65 + $2.25x0.35 = $20.29 against $19.49 - a 4% edge carrying an 88% left tail. The kill is the price and the floor, not the science. 4) MINOR - the funding leg holds. No offering has priced against the S-3ASR shelf filed 3 Mar 2026 (no offering 8-K on EDGAR through 28 Jul 2026), so there is no pre-readout dilution; the shelf is live for an immediate post-win raise, which caps the upside capture on a good print. 5) MINOR - catalyst status CONFIRMED live. No 8-K since 4 June 2026 and no company release since 23 June 2026, so the readout has not fired, slipped, or been withdrawn; Q3-2026 guidance was reaffirmed in writing on 7 May 2026. 6) HOUSEKEEPING - the prior shard for this symbol (pass dated 2026-06-29, verdict CONFIRMED_WITH_CORRECTIONS at $15.67) also emitted a numeric conviction_cap of 68, which the current contract forbids. That field is removed, and that verdict is superseded by this one on price, not on any change in the science.
